BOSS BATTLE\nWin the battle against Finstern the Dark Dragon!!
D-d-d-dragooon!!\nI-i-i-it's my first time seeing it, I'm almost\nparalyzed...
Umm? Hey humans, how did you get here?\n...What? Umm...
How dare you trespass on Shrine of the Gods!\nAnd it's Dunkelis' Hall! I see you're not afraid of\nthe dark, lemme send you to the Dark Realm...
Hmm, I used to say that a lot before.\nMy duty was to stop those who tried to go to\nDarkan from Mithurna...
Our leader, Dunkelis, told us to protect the people,\nso now my subordinates & I are working to stop the\ninvasion of the weird creatures from Eldenbaum...
Oh, no wonder I don't see any monsters like\nCoenubia in the mountains...
Seems like Dunkelis, the Goddess of Darkness, is\ntrying her best to come with a game plan to\nprotect the world from the Dark Realm...
...What? You said you wanna go to Eldenbaum?\nNo, that's not happening...\nEldenbaum is like a monsters' den...
I've been commanded by Dunkelis to protect the\npeople, there's no way I would let you go to such a\ndangerous place. Just go back to your human world.
You need to go to Eldenbaum to get rid of the evil\nbeings there. You can't turn back now!!
You wanna fight? Okay, but I won't go easy on you!\nDon't regret it if you return to the Dark Realm...\nLet's do this!!
You emit the scent of darkness.\nI see you have come in contact with the power of\ndarkness in the past...
You said you came from Dunkelis' Hall...\nthat means this is not just a coincidence or about\nbeing lucky. Kkkkk, interesting.
Fine, go ahead then. It's not a bad idea either\nto see how things have turned out in Eldenbaum,\nbut you can't go directly...
W-what do you mean??
Go and see for yourself...\nNow, off you go!
I wanna see how well you could handle those evil\nbeings in Eldenbaum. I'll be watching from here...
